D: A struggling London actress working as an elf in a year-round Christmas shop meets someone who changes everything.
P: Serve the sweets when Kate clocks on at the Christmas shop.
S: Covent Garden cevapi rolls with ajvar
Grilled beef and lamb sausages in soft rolls with ajvar and sour cream

Charred Balkan beef and lamb cevapi in soft rolls with smoky red capsicum ajvar, sour cream, raw onion and parsley. Mix 300g beef mince, 200g lamb mince, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp sweet paprika, 1/2 tsp bicarb and 1 tsp salt and knead 2 minutes. Roll into 16 short fingers and chill 30 minutes. Grill over high heat for 8 minutes, turning, until charred. Split 4 soft rolls and toast. Spread with 4 tbsp ajvar, add 4 cevapi each and top with sour cream, finely diced onion and parsley.
Santa's shop mince pies with orange cream
Shortcrust mince pies served with orange cream

Buttery little mince pies with star lids, warmed and dusted with icing sugar, served with orange zest and brandy whipped cream. Cut 12 rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust pastry and press into a greased patty pan tin. Fill each with 1 heaped tbsp fruit mince from a 400g jar. Cut 12 stars from a third sheet and lay on top. Brush with beaten egg and bake at 190C for 18 minutes until golden. Whip 200ml thickened cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar, the zest of 1 orange and 1 tbsp brandy. Dust the pies with icing sugar and serve warm.
M: Capsicums stuffed with beef and rice, baked in tomato, garlic yoghurt

Red capsicums stuffed with paprika-spiced beef and rice, baked in a rich tomato sauce and served with garlic yoghurt and crusty bread. Fry 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves, add 500g beef mince and brown. Stir in 100g long grain rice, 2 tsp sweet paprika, 1 tsp smoked paprika, salt and 150ml water and cook 5 minutes. Cut the tops off 4 large red capsicums, remove the seeds and fill. Stand in a dish, pour around 700g passata mixed with 200ml water and bake covered at 180C for 50 minutes. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove.
W: Spiced gingerbread with golden syrup, cinnamon and orange

Soft spiced gingerbread biscuits with golden syrup and orange zest, iced with lemon glaze in snowflakes and little stars. Melt 100g butter with 100g golden syrup and 80g brown sugar. Mix in 300g self-raising flour, 2 tsp ground ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon, the zest of 1 orange and 1 egg. Chill 30 minutes. Roll to 5mm, cut into stars and snowflakes and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Cool. Mix 150g icing sugar with the juice of half a lemon and pipe on snowflake patterns.
K: Red wine simmered with orange, cinnamon, star anise and clove

Red wine slowly warmed with orange, cinnamon, cloves, star anise and a little brown sugar, served steaming with an orange wheel. Pour 750ml red wine into a saucepan with 200ml orange juice, 3 tbsp brown sugar, 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 2 star anise and 1 sliced orange. Warm gently for 15 minutes, keeping it under a simmer. Ladle into heatproof glasses with an orange wheel. For anyone not drinking, warm 1L cloudy apple juice with the same spices.

dishes.n: Covent Garden cevapi rolls with ajvar

steps.text: Mix the minces with the garlic, paprika, bicarb and salt and knead briefly.
Roll into short fingers and chill.
Grill over high heat, turning, until charred.
Split and toast the rolls and spread with ajvar.
Add cevapi to each and top with sour cream, onion and parsley.

dishes.n: Santa's shop mince pies with orange cream

steps.text: Cut rounds from two pastry sheets and press into a greased patty pan tin.
Fill each with fruit mince. Cut stars from the third sheet and lay on top.
Brush with egg and bake at 190C until golden.
Whip the cream with some of the icing sugar, the orange zest and brandy.
Dust the warm pies with icing sugar and serve with the orange cream.

ingredients.item: garlic cloves (2 for the filling, 1 for the yoghurt)

steps.text: Fry the onion and two of the garlic cloves, add the mince and brown.
Stir in the rice, both paprikas, salt and a little water and cook briefly.
Cut the tops off the capsicums, remove the seeds and fill.
Stand in a dish, pour around the passata mixed with water and bake covered at 180C.
Mix the yoghurt with the remaining crushed garlic. Serve with crusty bread.

Mix the icing sugar with lemon juice and pipe on snowflake patterns.

ingredients.item: cloudy apple juice (for anyone not drinking)

steps.text: Pour the wine into a saucepan with the orange juice, sugar, half the spices and a sliced orange.
Warm gently, keeping it under a simmer.
Ladle into heatproof glasses with an orange wheel.
For anyone not drinking, warm the apple juice with the remaining spices.
